source_clause: HVACP10.) When head unit is in simulated off/idle mode HVAC popups should display as they normally would when idle mode is not applied.
reasoning: 驗證目標：14.10（HVACP10）定出 idle 模式下 popup 之顯示與非 idle 時相同，單一 leaf。關鍵情境條件：同 14.1.1。為什麼這樣切：一句一 leaf；其驗證形態為**前後對照**（§5.6），故首步先於非 idle 建立基線。刻意略過：條文未定義 idle 模式之進入方式（#34 之 `entry` 子類）；本條與 14.4 之界線 —— 14.4 驗「blank 畫面上只有 popup」，本條驗「popup 本身之呈現不變」，兩者可觀察量不同（§4.5）。

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: HVAC popup 本身（其顯示、內容與逾時）
interface_axis_review.axis_9: **不補** —— 6.3 之移除對象為 head unit 之 comfort section，而其明文例外正是 `except for comfort popups`；本節之可觀察量即 popup，故下螢幕車上仍在（**本批首次以證據放下該排除**）
interface_axis_review.axis_12: 不暴露 —— 不觀察 tab
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（3 旋鈕 ICS 車無 HVAC popup，出處 2.14）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: 補排除；**逐條答見各 TC 之 `emea_ics_review`** —— `ch16_mirror_map.tsv` 之 **ch14 側全無列**（ch16 十八節無 popup 專章），故全批皆為 `no-counterpart` 而 verdict `yes`

tcs.tc_title: Idle mode does not change how HVAC pop-ups display
tcs.test_item:
HVACP10.) When head unit is in simulated off/idle mode HVAC popups should display as they normally would when idle mode is not applied.

(put the head unit into simulated off/idle mode and change the fan speed again -> The fan pop-up is shown as it was in step 1)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [test-setup] The head unit is on and the climate system is on
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Change the fan speed using the fan speed hard control with idle mode not applied and read the fan pop-up
2. Put the head unit into simulated off/idle mode and change the fan speed again
tcs.expected_result:
1. The fan pop-up is shown
2. The fan pop-up is shown as it was in step 1
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

emea_ics_review.ch16_sentence: ch16 十八節無任何 HVAC popup 之專章（`ch16_mirror_map.tsv` 之 ch14 側全無列）—— 逐條之答為「ch16 無對應句」，故 EMEA ICS 車輛上本條無對象，排除成立

tcs.test_item_authored: When the head unit is in simulated off/idle mode, HVAC popups shall display as they normally would when idle mode is not applied
